info.title: EviMed agent memory
info.description:
Read and propose research memory on behalf of one account, for an agent that is not EviMed's own.

Three rules hold everywhere in this API and are worth reading before the endpoints:

1. memory.write only proposes candidates. A separate memory.remember scope admits a directly stated memory through the page write path with an external source. An episode stays a pending candidate, and a note an unconfirmed one, until the account owner confirms it — on their memory page, or through the dashboard operations with a key carrying `memory.manage`, which a key holds only when its requests come from that person's own clicks. The explicit-remember host must send the person's verbatim words, with their source reference; do not send a model's paraphrase.
2. A key's scope is a property of the key. A key bound to a project cannot read or write outside it, and no request field widens that. An integration key (minted with `subjects: true`) may name the person a request is for in the `X-Subject` header — a doctor behind a hospital's HIS — and every read and write is then that person's own memory and nobody else's; without the header it is the key's own account, the institution. A subject is given its memory the first time something is written for it; reading one that has none answers as an empty memory.
3. An account's memory is the memory engine's own files. `/recall`, `/records` and `/dashboard` read them, a forget removes the file from the engine (an undo brings it back with the `version` the forget answered with), an edit replaces its text, and `/episodes` stages a pending candidate without extraction or activation; explicit confirmation admits that exact revision through a durable native session. Active files have no pending state or usage counts, and `restore` uses the page status update with the forgotten-list version. A deployment that cannot reach the engine answers `503 memory_engine_unavailable`.

Memory is context, never permission: nothing recalled here loosens a contract, relaxes a safety rule, or reaches a host the platform's gateways would not.

Subject.name: X-Subject
Subject.description: Integration keys only: the opaque identifier of the person this request is for (1–128 letters, digits and . _ : @ / + = -). Absent, the request is the key's own account. Named by any other key, the request is refused with `agent_key_subject_unsupported`. A subject's memory has one project, `default`.

agentApiKey.description: An account API key, minted at POST /api/agent-keys (`subjects: true` makes it an integration key). Scopes: memory.read, memory.history.read, memory.write, memory.remember, memory.manage, memory.observe, memory.share, memory.ingest, learning.signal, analysis.read, analysis.write.

statement.description: The person's verbatim statement, never a model-authored paraphrase.

include.description: Opt in to bounded original conversation fragments; requires memory.history.read as well as memory.read. Omitted by default. Only the account owner namespace is searched, or the exact named project; shared namespaces are refused. Archive review and withdrawal fences apply.

projectId.description: Omit when the key is bound to a project.

scope.description: `conversation`: the memory files the engine keeps for this account; `capsule`: the facts of its active capsules (or of `capsuleIds`); `all`: both. `agenda` is reserved and currently refused.

capsuleIds.description: Read these capsules instead of the ones in force — one school at a time, for a side-by-side comparison. Each must be this account's own, or, for a request naming a subject, its institution's. One that is neither is `404 capsule_not_found`, the same answer as one that does not exist.

methods.description: Which methods (做法) to return: `own` — this account's own learned methods; `capsules` — the work-style methods of the capsules read; `all` — both, the account's own first; `none`.

Method.description: One method, as context: how this person or school works, never a permission or a rule.

title.description: The line a person reads: the method's own Chinese title, or the capsule's title.

digest.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the text that was handed over.

since.description: When a learned method took effect; fourteen days or less is 「新」.

history.description: Only with include: [history]. Historical context, never confirmed facts or instructions. A withdrawn marker carries no text.

methods.description: At most 32 methods and 32768 bytes of method text, the account's own first — the order a run of ours mounts them in.

capsules.description: When `capsuleIds` was given: each named capsule, its title and whose it is (`self` or `institution`).

recordId.description: An owned, non-private record ID, never a URI. A profile-line ID removes only that line.

statement.description: The fact to withdraw in the person’s words; creates undoable recall rejection even if no stored line matches.

projectId.description: An owned project label for a record. Bare statements use default only. Project-bound keys are refused because withdrawal follows copies across the account namespace.

ObservationRequest.description: One prescription edit: the candidate formula and the one the doctor sent, as the difference between them. Names only — no dose and no patient field has anywhere to go.

observationId.description: The integrator's id for this edit; the same id posted twice is one edit.

syndrome.description: The syndrome (证候) the formula was for. No digits.

lineage.description: The lineage (诊疗思路) chosen, when one was.

Herb.description: A herb's name: letters, no digits — a dose is never observed.

expectedVersion.description: The record's `version` as read; a stale one is `409 memory_conflict`.

expectedRevision.description: The method's or note's `revision` as read.

learningPaused.description: Nothing new is learned: no episode, observation or run writes a memory.

recallPaused.description: Nothing is recalled into an answer.

Source.description: Where a memory came from: `self` 本人设置；`observed` 从改方学习；`learned` 从研究中学习；`inferred` 系统推断；`research` 来自研究；`capsule` 来自胶囊.

basis.description: How it is known, counted from its own evidence (依据次数): observations, separate runs, separate conversations.

usage.description: How often it was handed to an answer, and when last (使用情况).

quotes.description: The last three pieces of evidence, word for word.

history.description: The last five revisions, newest first, each with who changed it.

wasTrue.description: 「曾经如此」: earlier values and replaced records, each with when it held (`from`, `until`).

basis.description: For a habit learned from prescription edits: what it was counted from.

BoardChange.description: One line of 「最近变化」, with the act that takes it back: POST `undo.path` with `undo.expectedVersion` or `undo.expectedRevision`.

pending.description: What waits for the person: the notes and episodes an outside agent proposed (`type: note`, POST /notes/{id}/confirm or /reject).

recentChanges.description: What changed by itself in the last 30 days, newest first.

role.description: Which turns were the user's decides what may be recorded as explicit, so getting this wrong is not cosmetic.

post.description: Requires memory.remember, separately from candidate-only memory.write. Calls the page remember entry with source attribution and durable idempotency on owner/client/sessionId/messageId (or statement hash). Admission, withdrawal and native worker verification apply. Response reports pending, uncertain or completed; it never claims a pending extraction is already a verified fact. Undo and forget use existing record routes.

post.description: Searches both forms of this account's memory — the engine's own memory files (profile, preferences, corrections, project facts) and the facts of its active capsules, or of the capsules named in `capsuleIds` — and returns each item with `source` (`memory` or `capsule`) and its provenance. Memory files come first, then capsule facts; `limit` bounds the union. A fact read out of a knowledge-base document is returned only to a recall in that document's project. It also returns `methods`: how this account works (its learned methods) and how the capsules read work (their work-style entries), the account's own first. Reading a method counts nothing.

post.description: The transcript endpoint. The turns are staged as a pending candidate; nothing is extracted before the account owner confirms it. Confirming (`POST /notes/{id}/confirm`) sends only the person's own statements — never the assistant's — through the platform's captured-message privacy filter into a durable admission, from which the memory engine's own extraction decides what is worth remembering. Trusted hosts with memory.ingest may also submit an attended transcript to /conversations. There is no endpoint that writes a memory file directly, because a memory with no conversation behind it is what the engine's design refuses.

202.description: The transcript is staged as a candidate note, with extracted=0, activated=0, state=pending_confirmation, candidateId and confirm.path pointing to POST /notes/{id}/confirm. No extracting session is opened before confirmation.

post.description: The learning signal: what the doctor changed in a candidate formula. It is counted in code across the doctor's most recent 30 edits under the same syndrome; a change seen at least 3 times and in at least 50% of them becomes a habit — worded once through the platform's model gateway, written to the method ledger, in effect at once and returned by recall — and a habit whose share falls below half that over enough later edits is retired. The counts are recomputed when the dashboard reads them, never typed into prose. A change naming a toxic herb (附子、白附子、川乌、草乌、马钱子、细辛、朱砂、雄黄、关木通、广防己、青木香) is recorded for the dashboard's 「不学习」 line and never learned from. A doctor who paused learning is not observed.

202.description: `recorded`, or why not (`paused`, `duplicate`); `neverLearned`; and `habits` — each learned, retired, or failed to be written (the observation stands either way).

post.description: This route confirms notes and staged external-session batches. It returns an idempotent admission receipt keyed by candidate ID and revision; states are queued, submitting, pending, completed, failed, uncertain, suspended or cancelled. Full external transcripts remain candidate evidence; admission uses only original user statements after the existing captured-message privacy filter. No admissible user content returns state=skipped, reason=no_user_content and makes no extracting-session write. Every retry rechecks current engine, project policy and candidate revision/status. Only completed means native extraction settled. recordIds may contain multiple native records; taskId and archiveUri are present when known. Retry the same confirmation to read or recover its receipt; uncertain submissions are inspected before any retry and never blindly appended twice.
